title: Poincaré duality on manifolds
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: Singular homology duality on topological manifolds with coefficients in any commutative ring: local homology, orientations and the orientation of manifolds with positive Jacobian coordinate changes (in particular complex manifolds), classes on compact subsets and fundamental classes, cap products and compactly supported cohomology with the Mayer-Vietoris compatibility of the duality map, Poincaré duality with its consequences over fields and self-injective rings such as Z/m, vanishing above the dimension, and the identification of the sheaf cohomology of a manifold with singular cohomology, with supports, with compact supports and for extensions by zero into compact spaces.
prerequisites: Core course D60 Algebraic Topology (Fomberg: Theorem 1.13, Corollaries 1.14 and 1.17, Theorems 1.21, 1.23, 1.26, Propositions 1.25, 1.29 and 1.35; Roberts: Theorems 13-15, Propositions 24, 26 and 27)
Characteristic classes, Thom classes and Euler classes (DG-CHAR-06): Lemma 5.1 and Theorem 5.2

Derived categories of sheaves: Injective modules and bounded-below derived functors (Lemmas 1.1 and 2.1, Proposition 1.3, Theorem 4.1); Sections with support and the localization triangle (Section 1, Theorem 2.1, Lemma 4.1)
AI Integrated Stacks Project, Cohomology of Sheaves: cohomology of a quasi-compact subset as a colimit over neighbourhoods
consumers: ag-etale-cohomology/comparison-with-singular-cohomology (classical duality, sheaf and singular cohomology, dimension)
related: DG-CHAR-07 Manifold duality, the diagonal and Wu classes, Theorem 2.2: Poincaré duality with compact supports for smooth manifolds
free_sources: A. Hatcher, Algebraic Topology (author's free edition), Section 3.3
H. Miller, Lectures on Algebraic Topology, MIT 18.905 (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), Lectures 32-34
